race.comment: Last start winners everywhere here in a very good contest but tipping VEYEPEE (6) is the best of them. His two wins this time in have been excellent, coming from a mile back fresh then way too good at Mornington. He's very progressive and with any luck from the gate he'll go close again. CLASSIC GEM (8) got her maiden out of the way first up at Bendigo at $1.55. Fourth in a G1 ATC Oaks last time in says she's right up to this sort of level with improvement to come. IN'KANTOSSTAR (9) has won three on the bounce. He's Jimmysstar's brother and is doing the family proud, too good again at the shorts at Caulfield Heath last time. Hard to knock. JUST DESSERTS (10) has won three in a row as well and has the benefit of racing on speed. Can't see the trip pulling him up, very hard to catch.

CALL ME SASSY (15) rewarded for her consistency when she gripped on late to score a narrow win over 1300m at this track in Midway class. Claim helps again from the tougher draw. Place best. VETWELVE (12) peaked on the run second up when fifth in this class. Well drawn and goes into the exotics.

race.comment: SEQUINNED (5) comes down from Sydney with the A1 form lines for a race like this. She won two in a row at the midweeks impressively before being given some hope in the G2 Tea Rose Stakes and battling away for fifth. Back to 1200m suits and J-Mac on helps. Very wary of GAS STATION ROSE (8) who recorded some big late sectionals to win first up at Ballarat. Tougher now but fancy she'll measure right up. MOANA SPIRIT (2) resumes having shown plenty last time in, winning her first two then starting $4.20 in a G2 Blue Diamond Prelude. She's been given time and has won a jumpout, keep safe. ROSEATIC (10) and FIERY FUN (9) are both off dominant maiden wins at Moe and Seymour respectively, it wouldn't surprise if either measured right up.

race.comment: VENUS INVICTA (2) gets the nod on debut with Capitalist speed in the pedigree and a Group 1-winning trainer in Kelly Schweida behind her. Doomben trial win in readiness was sharp. Looks set for a bright start. HIGHWIRE QUEEN (1) looks the main danger, a Trapeze Artist filly from Jami Lady. Gets the key booking of Thompson off a trial win in readiness. MISHANI KIMITSU (5) jumps from a wide draw, so will likely settle back in the ruck and be warming late. Is another that impressed in her lead-up work. BETTER BE DONE (9) comes through the same trial as VENUS INVICTA coming in and comes from a successful family with all of her siblings being race winners. Not to be discounted.

race.comment: SUPER WONDER (3) has been given a let-up since dropping out over this course and distance six weeks ago. Led all the way for an arrogant win over 1000m at the Parks circuit the run prior. A strong recent trial win suggests he is going to set the record straight today. OLE GO (1) is the class runner back from a 24-week spell. Led and just failed to hold out Verzain first-up last prep in the Listed Without Fear over this track and trip. Toyed with his rivals in a trial here on 28 September. Can win despite the 61kgs. OUR BRAVE BOY (5) was backed as though unbeatable first-up at Murray Bridge but ran into some dead-ends and probably should have won. Promising three-year-old who draws a lovely gate and should be right in the thick of things. CZECH OUT (2) came wide and finished too well over 1000m at Murray Bridge recently. Competitive with Verzain last prep which ties in well with OLE GO. AZYTASS (6) is consistent and has placed at both runs here at today's trip.

race.comment: WYANDRA (11) should have won a race by now, and is resuming from a spell still with the Moody/Coleman stable, which is a good sign. A couple of tune-up jump-outs will have him ready fresh up, and in an even maiden field at this track, he should be hard to hold out. BIG VEE (3) cops a wide gate third up from a spell, and his first 2 starts this season have yielded a couple of minor placings. Include in all top 4 combos. ACCUSER (1) has been given plenty of time to mature before making his debut, and he has won both of his jump-outs this season. If not too green, he can make an immediate impact. Check the markets. BALSINO PRINCE (2) makes his debut from a good draw, and he has won his only public jump-out. Keep him safe. HINEY'S BAR (5) had no luck on a heavy track fresh up at Warrnambool, and he has been back to the jump-outs since then. A wide gate is no help, but he is still worth including in all combos.

race.comment: CONFUCIOUS FLYER (2) is a first starter by Doubtland out of a Henny Hughes mare who has produced five individual winners of 22 races. Been to the trials twice and won them both, the latest by 7.5 lengths on the Parks circuit. Clearly has the talent to win a race like this. GIFT OF SILENCE (12) settled near the tail of the field then closed powerfully to just miss on debut over 1100m at Murray Bridge last time out. Back a little in distance but has been given a 31-day let-up. Won't spend a cent from the inside gate and is going to be hard to hold out. EXPEEARE (3) has raced on the speed but failed to finish the race off in his two appearances to date, both over 1250m. Sure to run a cheeky race over this sharper journey. KLASYK MODE (13) is a four-year-old Kermadec mare on debut. Has won three of her five jump-outs. Looks ready to make her presence felt after a long wait for connections. COLD COPY (1) is another first starter who is doing everything right on the track.

race.comment: Tricky race with little wet track form to assist. SPY TRADER (2) has not raced for ten months but appeals as the hardest to beat. Last appeared when he returned an excellent figure in finishing a very close second at Goulburn over 1200m. Nicely drawn and a likely improver this time in work. REGOR (1) returned from an 11-month break with a game second over 1200m at Goulburn last start, leading until the closing stages. Met with strong market support that day so the effort came as no surprise. Great chance to go one better. JENNI MOO MOO (9) is a 14-start maiden who placed a couple of times over shorter trips before making late ground to finish fifth most recently over 1200m at Goulburn. Should be thereabouts again. THE MAJOR (3) showed pace but weakened out of the placings on debut over 1050m at Leeton last start. Can improve with that race experience now on board. A gap to the next best CONARGO (6) who is a trifecta/first four chance at best.

race.comment: The first of a couple of famed Manangatang maidens and MISIL BEAUTY (7) looks the testing material in this one. Found the placings at Griffith two starts back before finishing fourth over 1900m at Leeton last time. Back in trip here but gets blinkers on and draws beautifully. MEET THE PRINCE (10) missed the placings two starts back when resuming then ran a better race and finished 1.75 lengths away in sixth last time out over 1400m at Coleraine. Has the ability to take care of this field. SHAYKHLISLAMOVA (9) got into the placings a couple back, albeit beaten a long way, then finished much closer last time up. Rises back in trip here, which might secure an even better result. SCARTAKA (12) hasn't placed in six runs to date, but has been around the mark and gets out to this trip for the first time in his career. LADY COLONIST (6) lost the rider last time out, but did start $3.40 off some performances that looks the right form for this.

race.comment: ARTIE VAINQUEUR (6) is the one to beat after back-to-back wins at this track, the latest a CL2 success where she justified favouritism by leading pillar-to-post. Her record at this venue, at the distance and her association with Emmerson make her tough to look past. APOLLO TEN (2) comes through stronger BM65 races and was doing his best work late at Gold Coast, so the easier set-up and apprentice claim make him the main danger. LITTLE VAIN (5) boasts a strong record over this trip, and his Beaudesert win two back keeps him in the thick of it. BUTT HEADS (4) has to put a plain Toowoomba run behind him, but his close second the start prior and perfect record at this track give him a sniff. RUMBLE TOWN (7) has been thereabouts in his two runs back and should be nearing a peak now. Worth keeping in mind.

race.comment: BAT OUT OF HELL (5) relished his first trip north of the border with a smart win here last time. The move to 1400m suits and he gets some weight relief. Can make it two on the trot. METAPHORICALLY (1) is the obvious danger with consecutive wins at Ipswich and Gold Coast, the latest as favourite. Loves this trip and gets and keeps Youngberry's claim. Have to take seriously. SUPERALLOY (6) was a big improver last time when getting the verdict at Toowoomba, where he was hampered early yet still finished over the top of them. The extra 100m should only suit. LITTLE BEGINNINGS (2) was tough out in front at the Gold Coast last start and has stacks of experience at this distance. Suspect the hunt forward again from out there and try and lead all the way. BOONDOCKS (9) should also inject some pace but is dropping sharply in trip. Keeping safe.

WOMBAT (3) is another returning from a spell and he's run some nice races in better maidens than this, so he warrants respect. HELLISH LEE (5) also resumes and is at her best over a little further than this, but as placed first up in the past so could pull out a run. MINTY (10) is a 3YO filly on debut for the Patrick Payne yard and has had six trials and jumpouts in readinesas for her debut effort. Drawn to get her chance for Beriman and she can play a leading role.

race.comment: SIYAASI (1) continues to impress deep into his maiden prep. Raced handy and battled on well under 61.5kgs last start over 1350m at Griffith, clocking in second. Has a win and four placings from five starts on wet tracks. Sure to play a key role again. ROSARY SISTER (4) stepped up to 1400m for the first time and recorded a tidy maiden win at Nowra last time out. Progressing in good style and looks ready to take on this better field. NOIR VITESSE (2) returned from a six-month spell with a modest effort over 1300m at Corowa recently. Not sure he is at his best on tracks with give but his best ratings put him right in contention. The speedy WESTERN LIGHTS (5) knocked up after leading for home over 1200m at Cootamundra last start. Placed at three of five heavy track runs so the surface condition brings her into the conversation. ICONIC ROSE (6) battled on well at the end of 1200m last time so today's trip should suit.

race.description: Melbourne Cup @ Port City Bowling Club Hcp (C1)
race.comment: MARKWELL TOPSORT (2) was a good winner over this course and distance two weeks ago. He sat midfield and found the line nicely. Hard to see him not running at least to that level again. PUTINACALL (5) will be resuming off two nice runs at Tamworth. He will just need a little luck off the draw so watch the market. HOME SIREN (6) is another kicking back off in this. She did win her only attempt at this track. Then she took on much much tougher grade. SUPIDO STAR (1) has done little wrong to date. She does get back and find the line. DON'T (3) can put himself on the pace. Probably wants it to be very wet.
